数据缓存做出来之前，这一项不生效、不可配。: Until data caching exists, this setting has no effect and cannot be configured.
数据缓存落在 storage/cache/data 下，按哈希分片存放；这里显示: The data cache lives under storage/cache/data, sharded by hash; this shows the current disk usage.
数据缓存还没做，现在只有模板编译缓存（写在磁盘上），所以这一项暂时不可配。: Data caching is not built yet — only the template compile cache (written to disk) exists, so this setting cannot be configured for now.

整页缓存属必备项，所以不做开关（做出来后固定开启）。只缓存未登录访客看到的正常页: Full-page caching is a required layer, so there is no switch (it will always be on once built). It only caches normal pages seen by signed-out visitors; on a hit, the request skips the program and returns the page directly.
文件、Redis 等任一种: Any one of: files, Redis, etc.

新分类立即可用，文章编辑页的选单会同步出现。: A new category works right away—it shows up in the post editor’s picker.

新建文章时先按这里的设定填好，落笔前仍可改。: A new post is prefilled per these settings, and you can still change them before you write.
新评论进哪个状态、在文章下方怎么排。: What status new comments enter, and how they are ordered below the post.
新评论进来时的默认状态。选「已通过」等于不做人工审核。: The default status for new comments. Choosing "Approved" means no manual review.
无未完成的事务 / 待执行的数据库升级冲突: No unfinished transactions / pending database upgrade conflicts

昵称会出现在文章署名与评论区；用户名只用于登录。: The nickname appears in bylines and comments; the username is only for signing in.
显示在浏览器标签与页脚版权处。: Shown in the browser tab and the footer credit.

标签不分层级，也不设兜底项；删掉一个标签只是解除归属，文章本身不动。合并同类项请: Tags have no hierarchy and no fallback item; deleting a tag only detaches it—posts stay put. To merge duplicates, re-tag them in the editor.
标签不分层级，也不设兜底项；删掉标签只解除归属，文章本身不动。: Tags have no hierarchy and no fallback item; deleting a tag only detaches it—posts stay put.
标签平铺，不分层级。同义词请自己收好，系统不做合并。: Tags lie flat with no hierarchy. Keep synonyms tidy yourself—the system does not merge them.

桌面与移动端共用这一套项目与顺序。: Desktop and mobile share this same set of items and order.

Community packages pass machine review only and stay out of default recommendations — switch to the Community tab to reveal them.

用 {hash} 占位邮箱哈希（md5 小写）；没有它就只能取到同一张图。留空自: Use {hash} as a placeholder for the email hash (lowercase md5); without it you always get the same image. Leave blank to fall back to Gravatar.
用 {hash} 占位邮箱哈希（md5 小写）；留空自动回落 Gravatar。: Use {hash} as the placeholder for the email hash (lowercase md5); leave it empty to fall back to Gravatar.
用于接收通知与找回密码。: Used for notifications and password recovery.
用于接收通知与找回密码，不会公开显示。: Used for notifications and password recovery; never shown publicly.
用于登录，创建后不可更改。: Used for login; cannot be changed after creation.
留空保持原口令: Leave empty to keep the current password

留空表示不修改。改动密码后，他在其他设备上的登录会失效，需要重新登录。: Leave blank to keep it unchanged. After a password change, his logins on other devices stop working and he must sign in again.

硬性项全过才允许开始 · 「最近一次备份」只作提示，不拦升级: Every hard item must pass to start · "Latest backup" is only a hint and never blocks an update
确认删除，不可恢复: Confirm delete — this cannot be undone

站点的基本信息、写作与阅读偏好都在这里。改动保存后立即生效。: The site’s basic info and writing and reading preferences live here. Changes take effect as soon as they are saved.

管理员单独授予: Granted per user by an admin

结构里可用的字段，发布时按这篇文章自己的信息替换。: The fields available in the structure; on publish they are replaced with this post’s own info.

编辑页每隔这么久存一份草稿，同时留修订版本。离开前若有未保存的改动会提醒。: The editor saves a draft at this interval and keeps a revision too. You are warned before leaving if there are unsaved changes.
缺少词条时回落简体中文。: Missing entries fall back to Simplified Chinese.

要同时含字母和数字: Must contain both letters and digits
要彻底删除请先把那一格勾上。: To delete permanently, tick that box first.
角色是一组能力的集合，换角色就换一批权限；额外能力单独加在人身上。: A role is a bundle of capabilities—switch roles and the whole set changes; extra capabilities are granted per user.
设置文件不该这么大，检查一下是不是选错了文件。: A settings file should not be this large; check that you picked the right file.
访客能不能自己注册账号，以及站点默认用哪种语言。: Whether visitors can register their own accounts, and which language the site uses by default.
评论随所属文章一起导出，含待审与垃圾状态。: Comments export together with their posts, including pending and spam states.

读者的话都停在这里等一次判断。通过的才会上线，垃圾的不会打扰任何人。: Readers’ words stop here for a verdict. Approved ones go live; spam bothers no one.
谁在何时做了什么，都在这里。敏感字段进日志前一律脱敏，密码与令牌永不落盘。: Who did what, when—all here. Sensitive fields are masked before they reach the log; passwords and tokens never touch disk.

账号不存在时也会给出同样的提示，不透露注册情况。: The same notice appears even if the account does not exist, so registrations are not revealed.

这个插件装不上（清单读不出来），删不了；请用下方「装不上的」表里的「清理」。: This plugin cannot load (its manifest is unreadable), so it cannot be deleted; use “Clean up” in the “Not loadable” table below.

这些内容会出现在站点标题、页脚与搜索结果中。: These appear in the site title, footer and search results.

默认先按 EXIF Orientation 把图转正，再在对外副本上剥掉 GPS: By default the image is first rotated upright according to EXIF Orientation, then GPS and device info are stripped from the public copy; the original file is untouched and admins can still download it. The public copy is re-encoded by GD, which redraws pixels, so "fully keep" EXIF is objectively impossible — hence only the strip option exists.
